cleanerChat.Name: Cleaner Chat
cleanerChat.Hint: Hide avatars and usernames in chat headers.

HideChatFormatting.Name: Hide Chat Formatting
HideChatFormatting.Hint: Hide the ProseMirror formatting toolbar in chat.

hideChatInitiative.Name: Hide Chat Initiative
hideChatInitiative.Hint: Prevent initiative roll messages from being created in chat.

HidePrivateMessages.Name: Hide Private Messages
HidePrivateMessages.Hint: Hide private rolls from users who should not see them.

AllowPlayerMedia.Name: Allow Player Media Uploads
AllowPlayerMedia.Hint: Allow players to send images and GIFs in chat.

SplitGameChat.Name: Split Chat & Game Tabs
SplitGameChat.Hint: Show dice rolls and other system messages in their own Game tab. Disable to merge them into the Chat tab.

hideDamageTraits.Name: Hide Damage Traits
hideDamageTraits.Hint: Hide trait tags on damage rolls.

traitFilter.Name: Trait Filter
traitFilter.Hint: Hide low-impact traits and limit visible chat traits to 3. Click to expand.

Pin.NoGm: No active GM is available for pin requests.
